skill.name: starknet-wallet
skill.description: Manage Starknet agent wallets with balance checks, token transfers, contract calls, session-key workflows, account deployment, and gasless transaction guidance.
skill.summary: Operate Starknet wallets and account-abstraction workflows for AI agents.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: All 137 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. Reported shell execution is Markdown or JavaScript interpolation, while environment and URL references are disclosed wallet configuration and documentation; no prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Wallet configuration includes a private signing key.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated low-balance account, restrict session-key permissions, and keep private keys outside prompts and version control.

remediation.issue: RPC and paymaster endpoints can be overridden by environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Document trusted endpoint selection and require user confirmation before transactions or gas-sponsored operations.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misclassify Markdown backticks and configuration examples.
remediation.suggestion: Mark documentation examples clearly and avoid representing Markdown snippets as executable shell commands.

content.value_statement: Starknet wallet tasks need accurate balances, transaction details, and key controls. This skill guides AI agents through account-abstraction wallet workflows with explicit configuration and transaction context.
actual_capabilities: Check one Starknet token balance for a supplied or configured account.
Check balances for multiple token symbols or contract addresses.
Prepare token transfer requests, including documented gasless options.
Describe Starknet contract read calls and write invocations.
Guide account deployment, session-key setup, and agent identity registration.
Explain swap quotes and AVNU-based swap workflows.
limitations: Does not guarantee transaction success, prices, gas costs, or paymaster availability.
Requires a configured Starknet RPC endpoint and wallet credentials for signed operations.
Cannot recover lost private keys or reverse confirmed blockchain transactions.
Users must verify recipients, token contracts, networks, and approvals before signing.

use_cases.title: Review a portfolio balance
use_cases.description: Check ETH, STRK, or token contract balances before planning an action.

use_cases.title: Prepare a controlled transfer
use_cases.description: Review recipient, token, amount, and gas mode before submitting a Starknet transfer.

use_cases.title: Set up agent wallet access
use_cases.description: Plan account deployment and scoped session-key permissions for an AI agent.

prompt_templates.title: Check one balance
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Starknet ETH balance. Ask for the wallet address and network if they are not configured.

prompt_templates.title: Compare token balances
prompt_templates.prompt: Show balances for ETH, STRK, and USDC in this Starknet wallet. State network and token contracts used.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Starknet transfer of 10 USDC. Verify recipient, token contract, network, estimated fees, and confirmation requirements before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Design session-key controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a least-privilege Starknet session key for a trading agent. Limit contracts, methods, spending, duration, and revocation process.

output_examples.input: Check my STRK balance on Starknet mainnet.
output: Result: Balance retrieved for provided wallet
Next step: Verify token contract before transferring
Transfer should not be submitted until user confirms final details

output_examples.input: Create a session-key policy for swaps.
output: Scope contract and approved swap methods
Set a spending cap and expiration
Keep a revocation path for the parent account

best_practices: Use a dedicated low-balance wallet and least-privilege session keys for automation.
Confirm network, recipient, token contract, amount, and fees before every signed transaction.
Store private keys in secure environment management and never paste them into prompts or source files.
anti_patterns: Do not use a main wallet private key for unattended agent operations.
Do not trust token symbols without verifying the token contract and network.
Do not submit transfers or approvals without explicit final user confirmation.

faq.question: Which networks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It documents Starknet workflows. Configure an RPC endpoint for intended network and verify network before signing.

faq.question: Does this skill hold private keys?
faq.answer: No. Signed operations require wallet credentials supplied through secure local configuration.

faq.question: Can it send tokens?
faq.answer: It documents and prepares token transfer workflows. Confirm all transaction details before execution.

faq.question: What is a session key?
faq.answer: A session key is scoped signing authority that can limit duration, contracts, methods, and spending.

faq.question: Can it use gasless transactions?
faq.answer: It describes paymaster-based gasless options. Availability and eligibility depend on configured provider and network.

faq.question: Can it reverse a transaction?
faq.answer: No. Confirmed blockchain transactions are generally irreversible.
